field.label: Manual config
field.help: Disable kea-dhcp-ddns.conf generation and manage the file manually.

field.label: Qualifying suffix
field.help: Default FQDN suffix appended to hostnames (e.g. dyn.example.com.). Must end with a dot. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Send updates
field.help: Default for sending DDNS updates. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Update on renew
field.help: Default for sending DNS updates on lease renewals. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Override no-update flag
field.help: When enabled, Kea performs DDNS updates even if the client's DHCP FQDN option (Option 81 / Option 39) asked the server not to. Required for Windows clients, which commonly set the "N" flag but never perform the forward update themselves. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Override client update flag
field.help: When enabled, Kea performs the forward DNS update itself even when the client signaled it would do so (FQDN flag "S=0"). Useful for Windows clients that promise to update DNS but cannot reach the configured DNS server. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Replace client name
field.help: Default for replacing client-sent hostnames. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Conflict resolution
field.help: Default DHCID conflict resolution mode. Can be overridden per subnet.

field.label: Generated prefix
field.help: Default prefix for auto-generated hostnames when replacing client name (Kea default: myhost). Can be overridden per subnet.
